protocol.byteDefinition: CDP received network bytes including reported overhead; failed/unfinished transfers remain explicitly unresolved
protocol.scope: Main CDP session; service workers blocked; child-frame coverage incomplete; no network interception or request blocking
protocol.phaseMeaning: Cumulative totals in one context; deltas are additional bytes since the preceding checkpoint, not independent page loads

discovery.scope: DNS TXT, root, well-known, HTTP header; up to six linked, supplied, or common-path disclosures, with one-hop follow-up. Not an exhaustive search or verification of claims.
discovery.discoveryProfile: carbon.txt website v0.x FAQ order; not an implementation of the separate 1.0-RC1 IETF draft

technology.interpretation: Heuristic detections, not calibrated probabilities or proof of deployed versions. Missing detection is not absence. Separate browser and requests excluded from page-load totals.

https://guide.wagtail.org/en/.followUp: Review Wagtail renditions, rich-text output, templates, and cache invalidation before proposing framework replacement or client-side rendering changes.
Corroborate server-side caching and database work with runtime evidence; a framework fingerprint does not measure backend efficiency.
Separate CDN delivery from origin hosting; a CDN detection does not establish low-carbon electricity or origin cache efficiency.
